description: Get a Profit and Loss (Income Statement) report. Can be broken down by department/location.

columns.description: 'total' (default) shows only the total column. 'all' renders every column as a table — use with summarize_by to see per-department (or per-month) values, which are otherwise absent from the rendered output.

department.description: Filter to a specific department/location ID

detail_level.description: 'summary' (default) returns section totals only. 'account' also lists each account with its balance, so you do not have to open the full report file.

include_raw.description: Append the full raw report payload. Off by default: the rendered summary already carries the numbers, and the raw copy roughly doubles the response. Only needed for fields the summary does not render.

name: get_profit_loss
